n0.text: Fennel, my dear. Smell that? That's a nineteen-month Alpine, still cave-sweating.

n1.text: A wise cheesemonger knows: young cheeses are mild and hasty, aged cheeses are sharp and patient. Same as cats, really.

q.text: What would you like to know about?

choices.text: Tell me about the Last Wheel.

wheel.text: A hundred years old. They say one slice can heal a village, and one whiff can wake a sleeping giant. Gorgonzolo wants it to feed the Rot.

good.text: Patience, a little mould, and love. Also not leaving it near rats, evidently.

bye.text: Stay sharp, Fennel. Like a good cheddar.
